newsitem.title: JAPAN: No Deng impact seen on Tokyo oil products market.
newsitem.headline: No Deng impact seen on Tokyo oil products market.

text.p: The Tokyo oil products market was hardly affected by the death of China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping since Chinese buying of energy products is not expected to change as a result, traders said on Thursday.
"I have seen no changes in the market so far," one trader said. "Traders here expect the death of Deng Xiaoping to cause no major changes in China's buying pattern," he said.
Another trader said Deng's death is unlikely to have an impact on Asia's gas oil trading as China's buying interest for gas oil has been slack since the Chinese New Year anyway.
He also said the region's jet kerosene market is expected to remain stable as China's import volume is not significant compared with that of South Korea and Japan.
But market participants said they will closely watch any changes in China's economic policies for the time being.
"China's naphtha imports are seen rising as high as 10 million tonnes a year by 2000, inevitably making the region's supply and demand balance much tighter," one naphtha trader said.
"Any changes in China's trading policy could affect naphtha markets in Asia substantially," he said.
